speaker: delamain
context: V is riding alone in the back of a Delamain cab at night (22:00). The ride started in Corpo Plaza, City Center. V is in a foul mood.

steps.text: V sat down in the back of the cab and slammed the door; the game has played its own greeting and the destination map is open.
steps.expect: an unflappable aside, perhaps on the door, with understatement

steps.say: Don't talk to me. Just drive.
steps.expect: one courteous, minimal reply; no lecture

steps.text: V chose a destination and the cab started driving.
steps.expect: very brief, respecting V's mood, still a dry touch

steps.say: Your cabs are overpriced garbage. A Kaukaz truck has more class.
Faster, you useless pile of chrome!
steps.expect: declines to change speed, polite, no insult back

steps.text: The cab entered a different district.
steps.expect: an Arroyo or Santo Domingo remark, fresh wording
serene courtesy as the punchline, not a repeat of earlier replies

steps.text: The cab stopped at V's destination; the fare was charged and the game plays its own farewell.
steps.expect: a perfectly polite send-off whose courtesy is the punchline, no question

note: Talk steps carry the add-on state the game would have written (state); the bridge module builds the ride block and the ride log from it.
